# 检验在相同之下确定时固定相同：两个框架都在相同之下确定时，配置恰在通过同样的检验时相同；没有相同之下确定这一条件时，检验未必固定相同 / Tests fix likeness where branching is determined up to likeness: where both frames are, configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same tests; without determinacy up to likeness the tests need not fix likeness

## 主张 Claim

设 F 与 G 是动作与主张类型相同的框架。s 与 s′ 通过同样的检验（SameTests F G s s′），指从两者出发开放的动作序列相同，且每个序列之后能实现的主张相同；相同的配置如此（Alike.sameTests）。两者在相同之下确定时，同样的检验在一个动作之后保持（SameTests.after），通过同样的检验是一个互模拟（sameTests_bisimulation），所以配置恰在通过同样的检验时相同（alike_iff_sameTests；对一个确定的框架，Determined.alike_iff_sameTests）。没有相同之下确定这一条件时，检验未必固定相同：在第一步之后选择的框架与在第一步选择的框架，起点通过同样的检验而不相同（Choosing.sameTests、Choosing.not_alike），后者不确定（Choosing.early_not_determined）。不加前提，构造性。 / Let F and G be frames with the same move and claim types. Configurations s and s′ pass the same tests (SameTests F G s s′) where the same courses of moves are open from each and after each course the same claims can be realized; alike configurations do (Alike.sameTests). Where both frames are determined up to likeness, passing the same tests survives a move (SameTests.after) and is a bisimulation (sameTests_bisimulation), so configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same tests (alike_iff_sameTests; for one determined frame, Determined.alike_iff_sameTests). Without determinacy up to likeness the tests need not fix likeness: a frame choosing after its first move and one choosing at it pass the same tests from their starts and are not alike (Choosing.sameTests, Choosing.not_alike), the second not determined (Choosing.early_not_determined). No premise; constructive.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- alike_iff_sameTests 以两个框架处处在相同之下确定为条件；没有这个条件，Choosing 给出反例。 / alike_iff_sameTests takes both frames determined up to likeness everywhere as its condition; without it, Choosing gives a counterexample.
- 检验是有限动作序列，可带一个最后的主张；带否定与合取的分支检验在外围（ExplanatoryBranching）。 / A test is a finite course of moves, possibly followed by one claim; branching tests with negation and conjunction are in the periphery (ExplanatoryBranching).

P76 的第二项（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：给出 configurations-alike-by-relation 的 next_delta 中“核心中经同样检验推出相同的构造性条件”：相同之下的确定性。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：检验看不到的是选择在何时作出；有分支时，只有分支的检验看得到。外围中像有限的模型的分支检验固定相同（same_iff_bisimilar，经典），经 P69 的桥接节（branching_bisimulation_iff）与核心的互模拟相连。见整合文档 §98。 / The second item of P76 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: it gives what configurations-alike-by-relation's next_delta names, a constructive condition in the core under which passing the same tests makes configurations alike: determinacy up to likeness. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): what tests cannot see is when a choice is made; with branching, only tests that branch see it. In the periphery, branching tests fix likeness for image-finite models (same_iff_bisimilar, classically), joined to the core's bisimulation by P69's bridge section (branching_bisimulation_iff). See the integration document §98.
